page_title: LUT 3-4 ARS | Luton v Arsenal 05/12/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+9' The referee blows for the end of today's match.

90+7' 3 - 4 Goal! Martin Odegaard plays a neat lofted pass into the box for Declan Rice (Arsenal), who beats the defender in the air and plants a header into the right side of the goal from close range. 3:4.
90+5' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates.
90+5' Ben White (Arsenal) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender. Arsenal win a corner.
90+2' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) swings in the corner kick, but one of the defenders leaps highest to head the ball away.
90' The fourth official shows 6 min. of added time.
90' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
89' The foul by Chiedozie Ogbene (Luton) was seen by Samuel Barrott who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
88' Substitution. Ryan Giles (Luton) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Alfie Doughty walks off.
88' Substitution. Jordan Clark (Luton) on for Pelly-Ruddock Mpanzu.
88' Leandro Trossard (Arsenal) gets on the end of a pass on the edge of the area, but he drags his shot just wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Luton.
87' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) launches a powerful cross from the corner into the box, but the ball is intercepted by the defender.

87' What a save from Thomas Kaminski! Kai Havertz (Arsenal) jumps high to meet a cross and glances a promising header from close range towards the roof of the net, but the goalkeeper pulls off a brilliant save to keep it out. The ball goes out of play and Arsenal have been awarded a corner kick.
86' Ben White (Arsenal) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
83' Arsenal control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
80' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Arsenal comes to nothing.
78' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) launches the ball from the resulting corner, but one of the defenders is first to the ball and deals with the threat.
78' Leandro Trossard (Arsenal) fires the ball at goal from inside the area, but it's well blocked. Arsenal get a corner.
77' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) takes the corner which is cleared by the opposition's defence.
76' Kai Havertz (Arsenal) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort.
71' Pelly-Ruddock Mpanzu (Luton) strikes from the edge of the box, but hits it really poorly and sends the ball way over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Arsenal.
70' Gabriel Jesus (Arsenal) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Luton.
64' The game has come to an end for Gabriel Martinelli. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Leandro Trossard (Arsenal).
64' Substitution. Oleksandr Zinchenko (Arsenal) has come on for Jakub Kiwior.
62' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Chiedozie Ogbene (Luton) is coming onto the pitch as Andros Townsend cannot continue after picking up an injury.
61' Rob Edwards prepares a substitution. Jacob Brown is replaced by Tahith Chong (Luton).
61' Substitution. Carlton Morris (Luton) replaces Elijah Adebayo.

60' 3 - 3 GOAL! Superb work from Gabriel Jesus, who plays a vital role in the build-up. He squares it to Kai Havertz (Arsenal), who beats Thomas Kaminski with a brilliant shot into the bottom left corner. 3:3.
57' 3 - 2 Goal! Andros Townsend manages to prod the ball to Ross Barkley (Luton) after a melee inside the box, and he needs no second invitation to slot the ball into the bottom left corner. 3:2.
57' Arsenal seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
52' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
49' 2 - 2 Alfie Doughty takes over corner duties and expertly finds Elijah Adebayo (Luton), who jumps highest and coolly plants a bullet header into the left side of the goal. The score is now 2:2.
49' The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Luton.

49' Andros Townsend (Luton) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being blocked by one of the defenders. The ball is out of play. Luton win a corner kick.
47' Andros Townsend (Luton) sends a teasing cross into the area, but David Raya intercepts the ball.
46' Referee Samuel Barrott blows his whistle to start the second half.
45+6' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+5' Luton failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.

45+4' Alfie Doughty (Luton) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Luton.
45+1' Gabriel Jesus (Arsenal) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Samuel Barrott had an easy-decision to make.
45' There will be a minimum of 5 min. of added time.

45' 1 - 2 Ben White produces a beautiful lofted cross into the box, where Gabriel Jesus (Arsenal) rises high to head the ball into the left side of the goal and beyond the goalkeeper. He makes it 1:2.
44' Samuel Barrott shows a yellow card to Ross Barkley (Luton) for his blatant foul.
41' The ball is cleared after Issa Kabore (Luton) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. The referee and the linesman both signal a throw-in for Luton.
41' Gabriel Martinelli (Arsenal) takes the corner, but it's intercepted by the defender.

40' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) dribbled past his opponents before finding himself in a great position to strike. His attempt from just outside of the box went towards the left side of the goal, but it wasn't dangerous and Thomas Kaminski made a comfortable save. The ball goes behind for a corner. Arsenal will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
37' Elijah Adebayo (Luton) plays a through ball but overhits it. The ball is out of play. Arsenal will take a throw-in.
33' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Jacob Brown (Luton) was quite harsh and Samuel Barrott didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
32' A pass into the box finds Gabriel Martinelli (Arsenal) unmarked. He carefully places a shot towards the top left corner, but a brilliant last-ditch save by Thomas Kaminski denies him.
30' A cross from Andros Townsend (Luton) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.
28' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) quickly takes the corner kick with a short pass.

28' He should have scored! Gabriel Jesus (Arsenal) latches onto a pull back in the box right in front of goal, but his shot towards the bottom right corner is pretty weak and Thomas Kaminski makes an easy save. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Arsenal will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.

25' 1 - 1 Gabriel Osho (Luton) jumped highest inside the box to meet a perfectly executed corner kick by Alfie Doughty. His header was precise and ended up inside the left post, leaving the goalkeeper flapping in the wind. The score is 1:1.
25' The ball is out of play and Luton manage to earn a corner.
23' Gabriel Jesus (Arsenal) aims for the middle of the goal, but that's an easy job for the goalkeeper. It will take more than that to test him!

20' 0 - 1 Goal! Bukayo Saka plays in Gabriel Martinelli (Arsenal), who shows great determination to get to the ball before a couple of defenders and from inside the box slots it into the bottom left corner 0:1.
18' Gabriel Martinelli (Arsenal) looks to break free, but his touch lets him down and he loses the ball. It's a throw-in for Luton.
14' Elijah Adebayo (Luton) tries to latch onto a through ball, but it's too long. The ball goes out of play and Arsenal will have a goal kick.
14' Luton enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
8' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger.
7' Martin Odegaard (Arsenal) sends a long ball forward to Bukayo Saka, but he put too much power and the chance is gone. The ball is out of play. Luton will have a throw-in.
6' Gabriel Martinelli (Arsenal) is able to continue to play.
5' Gabriel Martinelli (Arsenal) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment.
3' Great teamplay by Arsenal as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
Arsenal will kick-off.
Samuel Barrott will referee today's match.
